name: end
summary: Reloads main entry 0, clears the active-lane mask and marks the script halted: main index +2576 = 0, stage +2580 = 0, cursor +2652 = main[0], lane word +3288 = 0, state +2659 = 2.
control_flow: returns the reloaded cursor; the interpreter continues from there

name: contents_return
summary: Resumes the saved contents cursor and switches the selection stage back to 0 (contents). Logged as "CONTENTS TBL END".

name: sub_contents_return
summary: Resumes the saved sub-contents cursor and switches the selection stage to 1 (sub contents). Logged as "SUB CONTENTS TBL END".

name: ground_area_move
summary: Steps the ground-area movement record for the current act id: looks up the act list at ground object +2900 -> +24 keyed by +2040, clamps the act/step indices +2657/+2658, picks the step motion byte into +2656, checks the distance to the step position, and either advances the step or places the entity. Logged as "GROUND AREA MOVE TBL END".
control_flow: on completion restores the saved cursor +2648 and clears +2581/+3231; otherwise returns the next instruction of the movement state machine

name: ground_area_move
summary: Same command as 0xff/0x04; the two selectors share one native block at 0x1086780a.

name: ground_area_move_snap
summary: Ground-area movement variant that jumps straight to the step-placement path when the saved command kind is the movement state (9) and the current instruction is 0x06, instead of advancing the step.
control_flow: uses the 0x10867715 entry of the 0xff/0x04 block; clears +2581/+3231 and restores +2648 when it ends

name: unko_end
summary: Hard reset to the first main entry: main index +2576 = 0, stage +2580 = 0, cursor +2652 = main[0][0], lane word +3288 = 0, state +2659 = 2. Logged as "UNKO_END".

name: no_floor_end
summary: Reset identical to 0xff/0x00, reached when the route has no floor. Logged as "NO_FLOOR_END".

name: find_ng_end
summary: Ends the target search: resets the main selection, then clears the hate bookkeeping of the slot held by em->cmd_pl_target (+2612). When +2612 is 0xFF the command ends as NOT_FOUND_PL without clearing anything. Logged as "FIND_NG_END em->cmd_pl_target == NOT_FOUND_PL" / "FIND_NG_END hate&flag clear".
control_flow: returns the reloaded cursor; the NOT_FOUND path returns through the default branch

name: clear_lane8
summary: Clears lane bit 0x0008. If lane bit 0x0001 is still set it resumes main[8][+2595]; otherwise it performs the full reset path.
control_flow: branch on the remaining lane mask

name: clear_lane4
summary: Clears lane bit 0x0004. If lane bit 0x0001 is still set it resumes main[8][+2595]; otherwise it performs the full reset path.
control_flow: branch on the remaining lane mask

name: clear_lane2
summary: Reloads the main selection, clears lane bit 0x0002 and calls 0x1084fb80(em, 0). If lane bit 0x0001 is still set it resumes main[8][+2595]; otherwise it keeps the reloaded cursor.
control_flow: branch on the remaining lane mask

name: area_end
summary: Ends a ground-area move: compares the progress counter +2844 with the limit +2845, keeps the saved cursor +2616 as the next cursor and clears the wait flag +2621. When +2620 is cleared the counters are forced to -1 and the command ends. Logged as "AREA_END".
control_flow: returns +2616; may end the movement state

name: find_end
summary: Ends the find/target command: when the command mode flag +2739 is zero it raises the trigger latch through 0x108693e0(em, 1) and copies +2680 into +2600, then resets the main selection and the lane word. Logged as "FIND_END Em_Mode_Chg( em, EM_MODE_ATTACK )".

name: kehai_end
summary: Ends the alert (kehai) route: clears lane bit 0x0010. If lane bit 0x0001 is still set it resumes main[8][+2595] ("route_ptr_set( em, em->cmd_route_act )"); otherwise it reloads the main entry and marks the network command state ("em_cmd_top( em ) ... EM_NET_CMD").
control_flow: branch on the remaining lane mask

name: route_move_end
summary: Ends a route move: refreshes the reference position with 0x108538b0, measures the distance to it and compares that with a radius chosen by species (+3) from 0x119a5dfc / 0x11860538 / 0x11604e90. While the entity is far away it resumes the lane cursor; once it is close it bumps the progress counter +2842, clears +3250 and picks the next waypoint value +2840 according to mode +2592: 0 = pseudo-random entry from the +2843 range using counter +1096, 1 = increment, 2 = byte from main[8][+2593]. Logged as "ROUTE_MOVE_END".
control_flow: resumes main[8][+2595] through the shared 0x10868107 path

name: loop_count
summary: Loop counter test for the route move: while the progress counter +2842 is below the limit +2841 it resumes main[8][+2594]; once the limit is reached it clears lane bit 0x0001 and lets the lane selector 0x10860700 choose the next cursor.

name: re-dispatch
summary: Any remaining selector is absent from both 0x108675a0 switch tables (0x108675d4 for 0x00..0x06 and 0x10867cdc for 0xf6..0xff). The handler returns the selector byte itself, so the interpreter dispatches it as a normal top-level opcode instead of skipping it.
control_flow: returns the pointer to the selector byte
